WITH tmp AS( SELECT ssrd.SEQ_NO, ssrd.INSTRUCTION_ID, ssrd.FINPROD_ID, ssrd.TRADE_MARKET, ssrd.CUSTOMER_ID, ssrd.ACCOUT, ssrp.PARA_VALUE, ssrd.FINPROD_TYPE, ssrd.PS, ssrd.TRADE_DATE, ssrd.TRADE_ID, ssrd.SEC_ACCT_ID, ssr.CHECK_RESULT, ssrd.SEAT_NUMBER, ssrd.COMMISSION_AMT, ssrd.JSF_AMT, ssrd.ZGF_AMT, ssrd.STAMP_FEE, ssrd.SETTLE_FEE, ssrd.GHF_AMT, ssrd.SXF_AMT, ssrd.TRADE_AMT, ssrd.TRADE_NUM, ssrd.TOTAL_TEEAMT FROM STL_SEC_RECON_DEAL ssrd LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_RECON ssr ON ssrd.SEQ_NO = ssr.SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, PARA_VALUE, MAX(CONFIG_DATE) FROM STL_SEC_RECON_PARA WHERE CONFIG_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND PARA_CODE = #{PARA_CODE_02} GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID, PARA_VALUE )ssrp ON ssrd.CUSTOMER_ID = ssrp.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE (ssr.CHECK_RESULT is NULL or ssr.CHECK_RESULT in (#{CHECK_RESULT_0}, #{CHECK_RESULT_2})) AND ssrd.TRADE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') ) SELECT tmp.SEQ_NO, tmp.TRADE_ID, tmp.FINPROD_ID, tmp.TRADE_MARKET, tmp.CUSTOMER_ID, tmp.ACCOUT, tmp.PARA_VALUE, tmp.FINPROD_TYPE, tmp.PS, tmp.TRADE_DATE, tmp.SEC_ACCT_ID, tmp.CHECK_RESULT, tmp.SEAT_NUMBER, tmp.COMMISSION_AMT, tmp.JSF_AMT, tmp.ZGF_AMT, tmp.STAMP_FEE, tmp.SETTLE_FEE, tmp.GHF_AMT, tmp.SXF_AMT, tmp.TRADE_AMT, tmp.TRADE_NUM, tmp.TOTAL_TEEAMT, std.APPLY_TRADE_ID TRADE_ID2, std.COMMISSION_AMT2, std.JSF_AMT2, std.ZGF_AMT2, std.STAMP_FEE2, std.SETTLE_FEE2, std.GHF_AMT2, std.SXF_AMT2, std.FPRICE_AMT2 TRADE_AMT2, std.SHARE_AMT2 TRADE_NUM2, std.FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, std.PS PS2, std.TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET2, std.TRADE_DATE TRADE_DATE2, std.SEC_ACCT_ID SEC_ACCT_ID2 FROM tmp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT APPLY_TRADE_ID, SUM(COMMISSION_AMT) COMMISSION_AMT2, SUM(JSF_AMT) JSF_AMT2, SUM(ZGF_AMT) ZGF_AMT2, SUM(STAMP_FEE) STAMP_FEE2, SUM(SETTLE_FEE) SETTLE_FEE2, SUM(GHF_AMT) GHF_AMT2, SUM(SXF_AMT) SXF_AMT2, SUM( CASE WHEN PS = #{PS_T01} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 != #{prodType2_F02} THEN FPRICE_AMT*-1 WHEN PS IN (#{PS_T07},#{PS_T54},#{PS_T55},#{PS_T56},#{PS_T95},#{PS_T96}) AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType2_F02} THEN FPRICE_AMT*-1 ELSE FPRICE_AMT END ) FPRICE_AMT2, SUM( CASE WHEN PS = #{PS_T01} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 != #{prodType2_F02} THEN SHARE_AMT WHEN PS IN (#{PS_T07},#{PS_T54},#{PS_T55},#{PS_T56},#{PS_T95},#{PS_T96}) AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType2_F02} THEN SHARE_AMT ELSE SHARE_AMT*-1 END ) SHARE_AMT2, FINPROD_TYPE2, PS, TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_DATE, SEC_ACCT_ID FROM SETTLE_TRANS_DATA GROUP BY APPLY_TRADE_ID,FINPROD_TYPE2,PS,TRADE_MARKET,TRADE_DATE,SEC_ACCT_ID ) std ON tmp.INSTRUCTION_ID = std.APPLY_TRADE_ID AND tmp.TRADE_DATE = std.TRADE_DATE WHERE tmp.PARA_VALUE = #{PARA_VALUE_02} UNION ALL

SELECT tmp.SEQ_NO, tmp.TRADE_ID, tmp.FINPROD_ID, tmp.TRADE_MARKET, tmp.CUSTOMER_ID, tmp.ACCOUT, tmp.PARA_VALUE, tmp.FINPROD_TYPE, tmp.PS, tmp.TRADE_DATE, tmp.SEC_ACCT_ID, tmp.CHECK_RESULT, tmp.SEAT_NUMBER, tmp.COMMISSION_AMT, tmp.JSF_AMT, tmp.ZGF_AMT, tmp.STAMP_FEE, tmp.SETTLE_FEE, tmp.GHF_AMT, tmp.SXF_AMT, tmp.TRADE_AMT, tmp.TRADE_NUM, tmp.TOTAL_TEEAMT, std.TRADE_ID TRADE_ID2, std.COMMISSION_AMT COMMISSION_AMT2, std.JSF_AMT JSF_AMT2, std.ZGF_AMT ZGF_AMT2, std.STAMP_FEE STAMP_FEE2, std.SETTLE_FEE SETTLE_FEE2, std.GHF_AMT GHF_AMT2, std.SXF_AMT SXF_AMT2, CASE WHEN std.PS = #{PS_T01} AND std.FINPROD_TYPE2 != #{prodType2_F02} THEN std.FPRICE_AMT*-1 WHEN std.PS IN (#{PS_T07},#{PS_T54},#{PS_T55},#{PS_T56},#{PS_T95},#{PS_T96}) AND std.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType2_F02} THEN std.FPRICE_AMT*-1 ELSE FPRICE_AMT END TRADE_AMT2, CASE WHEN std.PS = #{PS_T01} AND std.FINPROD_TYPE2 != #{prodType2_F02} THEN std.SHARE_AMT WHEN std.PS IN (#{PS_T07},#{PS_T54},#{PS_T55},#{PS_T56},#{PS_T95},#{PS_T96}) AND std.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType2_F02} THEN std.SHARE_AMT ELSE std.SHARE_AMT*-1 END TRADE_NUM2, std.FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, std.PS PS2, std.TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET2, std.TRADE_DATE TRADE_DATE2, std.SEC_ACCT_ID SEC_ACCT_ID2 FROM tmp LEFT JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA std ON tmp.TRADE_ID = std.CJBH AND tmp.SEAT_NUMBER = std.SEAT_NUMBER AND tmp.TRADE_DATE = std.TRADE_DATE WHERE tmp.TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL AND tmp.PARA_VALUE = #{PARA_VALUE_03} UNION ALL

a.FINPROD_ID, a.FINPROD_TYPE2, a.TRADE_MARKET, a.DEAL_DATE, a.ACCT_NO, a.SEAT_NUMBER, #{CHECK_RESULT_2} CHECK_RESULT, b.BROKER_ID, d.PARA_VALUE FROM SETTLE_TRANS_DATA a LEFT JOIN MST_SALE_DEPARTMENT b ON (a.SEAT_NUMBER = b.SH_SEATNO OR a.SEAT_NUMBER = b.SZ_SEATNO) LEFT JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_STATUS c ON a.TRADE_ID = c.TRADE_ID INNER JOIN ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, PARA_VALUE, MAX(CONFIG_DATE) FROM a.DEAL_DATE, a.ACCT_NO, a.SEAT_NUMBER, a.FINPROD_ID, a.FINPROD_TYPE2, a.TRADE_MARKET, b.BROKER_ID, d.PARA_VALUE ) e LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT f ON e.FINPROD_ID = f.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT g e.SEC_ACCT_ID SEC_ACCT_ID2, e.BROKER_ID CUSTOMER_ID, e.PARA_VALUE, e.SEAT_NUMBER FROM( SELECT a.FINPROD_ID, a.FINPROD_TYPE2, a.TRADE_MARKET, a.DEAL_DATE, a.ACCT_NO, a.SEAT_NUMBER, a.CJBH,
